sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Adds skip lengths from 10 seconds to 10 minutes to the player's speed settings.
Removes update prompts and forced updates.
Makes the quality choices in the player switch the stream to 480p, 720p or 1080p.
Starts videos at the highest available quality until you pick one in the player.
Unlocks full-length playback and VIP titles, and removes region blocks.

sources.label: Beyonder Morphe patches
sources.author: Beyonder
patch_list: Lets you choose how far the player skips when seeking, from the player settings.
Hides the blocking update dialog and the update prompt.
Starts videos at the highest available quality instead of 480p.
Makes quality selection work: 480p, 720p, 1080p and 4K actually switch to that resolution.
Unlocks VIP-only content and removes region restrictions.
